jobs.title: Data, AI, and Machine Learning Opportunities Available
jobs.description: Deloitte's Engineering AI & Data (EAID) team is an integrated group of industry specialists, technologists, and operations transformation experts who work with clients to transform and run their technology platforms, optimize their operations, and help them take advantage of new technologies, drive innovation, improve financial performance and accelerate speed to market. Deloitte looks for candidates with experience in Data and/or ML Engineering, with hands-on experience in Python or SQL, with dbt highly regarded, and a strong grasp of data fundamentals, preferably with experience with databases, data warehouses, data lakes or other storage solutions.

jobs.title: 2026 Graduate Program - Data Science & Analytics
jobs.description: The Data Science (Technical) role involves working on AI and machine learning projects, predictive modelling, data engineering, and the development of tools that shape the future of the business. The two-year graduate program is your chance to work on projects that matter, from building predictive models and unlocking insights to advancing AI safety and governance. You'll learn from experts, experiment with new technologies, and help bring bold ideas to life in a supportive and collaborative environment.

jobs.title: Data Scientist: AI and Machine Learning
jobs.description: As a member of the ML/AI FSP team you will work with top CSIRO scientists and engineers to develop new machine learning and artificial intelligence methods with a specific emphasis on solving significant science questions. A doctorate and/or equivalent research experience in a relevant discipline area, such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Earth Science, Engineering, or Computer and Information Sciences.

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI Products
jobs.description: The Product Manager - AI Products role involves supporting product strategy execution and roadmap delivery for a single AI product or squad aligned to Optus.ai objectives and business goals, contributing to product backlogs by writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria, conducting user research initiatives including interviews, surveys, usability testing, and behavioural analysis to understand user needs and validate solutions, collaborating with cross-functional squads including engineering, data science, design, and business stakeholders through the product development lifecycle

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: This team within ITSM works on using cutting-edge AI and machine learning algorithms to automate IT operational tasks, and by weaving Generative AI into the product revolutionises AIOps by moving from a traditional reactive troubleshooting-based system to a proactive problem-solving approach.

jobs.title: 2026 Graduate Data Analytics Program
jobs.description: EY has a 2026 Graduate Data Analytics Program that requires submitting an online application with passport/ID, CV, and academic transcript. Eligible candidates will be invited to provide their team preferences and motivations.

jobs.title: Agentic Data Specialist
jobs.description: This role involves designing, building, and managing the data and integrations that enable Agentforce agents to take meaningful, autonomous actions across various business systems. The position requires 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or integrations, such as a Data Engineer, Data Architect or Data Scientist.
